actions.label: Multi-factor Authentication
actions.definition: Requiring proof of two or more pieces of evidence in order to authenticate a user.

actions.label: Password Authentication
actions.definition: Password authentication is a security mechanism used to verify the identity of a user or entity attempting to access a system or resource by requiring the input of a secret string of characters, known as a password, that is associated with the user or entity.

actions.label: Account Locking
actions.definition: The process of temporarily disabling user accounts on a system or domain.
